notes: DiscoFlate v3.90.0 — 🟩 Word race: a group Wordle, built as a COMPETITION rather than a minigame. Everyone opts in with Enter Challenge and races the same hidden word in their own private grid, so nobody is locked up alone while the channel waits. Your score is the guesses you had LEFT — solve it in 2 of 5 and you score 4, fail and you score 0 — so the payout scales with how fast you got there, ties go to whoever solved it first, and Add all player totals pays the whole field by how well they did. The Competition Viewer card shows every player's progress live WITHOUT revealing the answer, which turns the thinking time into the show. Set the guess count per competition (2-10); no dictionary needed.
